paragraphs: Chapter 775
Episode 190. The Inheritance of Marliet Hister (5)
As I opened my eyes, the video was turned off and the blue glowing record windows were visible.
Valeria looked at the record windows for a while as if gazing at the stars, unable to take her eyes off them.
[How was it? The world of my master.]
“It was very beautiful.”
At the question of the golem, Valeria immediately answered without hesitation.
A clear moisture had gathered at the corner of her eyes.
Jin hesitated for a moment and then reached out his right hand with Valeria's left.
Jin's hard calluses scratched against Valeria's back of hand as their hands intertwined, and she did not pull away.
'Was the hand of my master this small?'

The feeling was quite different from when they held hands in their previous life. It was because Jin had grown more than then. In his previous life, Jin mainly leaned on Valeria, but now it was the opposite.
The two of them lay there for a while, looking up at the ceiling.
Don't push life into a barren, desolate place.
The will left by Marliet was igniting a fire in Valeria's inner self that she had never harbored before.
For example, the heart to love the world.
From birth, she carried a harsh fate, losing the people she walked with, and pursuing vengeance that was far away like a phantom, even if the days kept going.
Nevertheless, the feeling that something shining in life needs to be filled, the feeling that one has to reach out to someone, was being inherited from Marliet to Valeria.
Jin was also greatly impressed by Marliet's grand life.
Just like Marliet said, there needed to be more children in the world who aren't driven into battles.
"Valeria."
"Yes."
"I feel good because I feel like you are getting better."
That was something Jin often heard from Valeria in his previous life. Every time Jin got out of his crippled state, Valeria praised him.
[Oh, what is this? Nice picture. Woo woo woo.]
[Ha ha ha, isn’t it not the time for romance?]
Zhen and Teben, who entered talking like third-class villains. Jin and Valeria naturally let go of each other's hands as they stood up from their seats.
[So, can you take the grand test that we've prepared with all our hearts?]
While Jin and Valeria were watching Marliet's life, five hours had passed outside.
Zhen and Teben had prepared a test to give the communication device, which they had been considering for a while.
The golem let out a sigh and shook its head.
[Zhen, Teben. Really, if they fail the test, not giving the communication device, is an odd act. You created it to give it to your descendants.]
[Ha! Just like Marliet left traps, we only conduct the test!]
[We can't just hand it over!]
With heated faces, Teben and Zhen flashed their eyes (even as ghosts).

Although there were already enough achievements and inspirations in the inherited memory, it would not do to miss out on the ultra-long-distance communication device, which was the original main goal, and return.
If it was a test requiring force, like the traps in the inherited memory, there would be no reason to be nervous. But it didn't seem like the two would require a battle.
'What kind of test is it?'
'It's probably about magic or magical engineering.'
Even if it was a problem-solving test related to those topics, they felt confident.
Because Jin and Valeria were talented enough to get perfect scores even if they immediately took the top-level exams at the Vermont or Zipple Academy.
In the moment of rising tension and curiosity, Teben stepped forward.
[Ha ha ha! It seems you've figured out the situation now. Why, are you scared the test might be hard?]
[There's no such thing as easy in this world!]
"Ancestor, and Doctor Zhen. What is the prepared test?"
[That's...]
[Exactly!]
[Exactly, exactly!]
[Rock!]
[Paper!]
[Scissors!]
[Go!]
At the sight of Zhen and Teben alternately speaking in strange poses, the two were momentarily lost for words.
"...... Rock, paper, scissors?"
"Do we win if we beat the two of you at rock, paper, scissors?"
[Ha ha ha! That's right, rock, paper, scissors! No matter how strong you guys are, there's no answer for this.]
[Hmm! Thinking of this fair and perfect test made my research life rich.]
[I stake the name of Hister, if you can't beat us in rock, paper, scissors, no communication device for you!]
The content of the test, which they thought about passionately for a full five hours, was rock, paper, scissors...
Jin was again speechless, but Valeria felt somewhat swept up in their pace.
To Valeria's mind, rock, paper, scissors was purely a matter of luck. It was something you could lose at any moment.
[For your information, we've been training in rock, paper, scissors for the last 350 years.]
[Teben and I are almost like the grandmasters of rock, paper, scissors. No, we definitely are. Can young ones like you beat us?]
"Ancestor, you just said it was a fair test."

[Who's going first? The rules are simple. The first to win 20 games is the winner! Each person has ten lives. Lose ten times and you're out. Conversely, you can keep fighting your opponent until you lose ten times.]
[Decide the vanguard. We will have Teben Hister go first. The strongest always appear last, so I have no choice but to follow Teben.]
[What are you talking about, Zhen? You clearly just said I should go first because I'm stronger...]
[Hmm, must be a mosquito. Who's going first?]
Jin and Valeria exchanged awkward glances.
Valeria decided to go first. Jin was the one keeping his composure right now.
"I'll go first, ancestor."
[Good, a Hister versus Hister match will be even better to watch. Heh heh heh, let's start! Rock, paper, scissors!]
When Teben suddenly cried out rock, paper, scissors and stretched out his hand, Valeria quickly responded. The result was Teben paper, Valeria rock.
"Uh."

[Ha ha ha ha, this is the dignity of an ancestor. Rock, paper, scissors is actually a psychological battle. I have mastered it, while you are only a novice... Most people tend to choose rock when they are flustered. That's why you lost! Rock, paper, scissors!]
"Oh."

[Scissors? I have rock! Another victory for me. Good, next I will go with paper. If you choose scissors, you win. Heh heh heh, can you choose scissors? It's not a difficult thing. Rock, paper, scissors! Oh dear, instead of scissors, you chose paper? That's unfortunate.]
Expecting Teben to choose rock, Valeria went with paper, but Teben seemed to have anticipated this and chose scissors.
"You said you would go with paper..."

[The world of competition is harsh. You're paying the price for not trusting this ancestor! If you'd chosen scissors as I suggested, you could have at least drawn. Heh heh, that's why I say you're just young ones. Rock, paper, scissors!]

Surprisingly, Teben's claim of practicing rock, paper, scissors for 350 years wasn't an exaggeration. Teben relentlessly shook Valeria psychologically, pressuring her, and seemed to be reading her moves.
'I was wrong, the master is completely flustered.'
Valeria unusually continued rock, paper, scissors in a flustered state.

When the match was all over, the score between Teben and Valeria was 9:1. Valeria looked at the score written on the chalkboard by the golem with disbelief. She didn't expect to suffer such a ruthless defeat in rock, paper, scissors.
[Well done, Teben. You even spared the leisure of losing a game. Did you show mercy because she's our descendant?]
[Kekekeke. Zen, it looks like you won't even have a chance to step in.]
[But don't let your guard down, she's still calm.]
[You're not my descendant, so I'll win all the games...]
Now Jin had to take care of both of them alone.
"Jin, be careful. He was a real expert. How... how can this happen? It's just rock, paper, scissors."
Jin, nodding his head, stepped forward. A faint wind from somewhere passed between Jin and Teben.
[Young one from Runcandel, I'm going to play rock.]
"Do so."
[Oh? Pretending to be strong, huh. Hehe. Let's see if your boldness can continue. Rock, paper, scissors!]
Teben played rock, Jin played paper.
[Ho? You seem to have a bit more sophistication in your psychology. I feel like cooking you a little harder.]
"I'm going to play paper."
[Going as far as to provoke me in the opposite way? You need etiquette education! Rock, paper, scissors!]
This time Jin played scissors, and Teben played paper.
[...Scissors? Why would you play scissors here?]
"Is that so? I just changed it."
[You're an expert... or just lucky?]
"Rock, paper, scissors. As you see, I've played paper."
[What? I lost again?]
Jin swiftly killed Teben's momentum in this manner.
Teben didn't manage to win a single game of the remaining nine lives.
Valeria stared at Jin and Teben alternately with wide eyes.
[This can't be! You manipulated something!]
[No manipulation. Probability wise, it's slim, but it can happen.]
[Step aside, Teben. He was not your match.]
As Zen stepped forward with a heavy remark, Teben glared at him, grinding his teeth.
[Zen, stop acting like you're stronger than me!]
[Heh, it's disappointing to see you making a fuss about manipulation when you lost by your skills. Are you such a man, Teben?]
[That damn kid! Ah, don't stop me!]
As the golem and Valeria held Teben back, Zen smiled slyly.
[I feel a chill throughout my body, as if I've met a worthy opponent after a long time... Jin Runcandel. If you can defeat even this Zen Route, I will give you the communication device.]
"If you're ready, let's start."
A moment of tension flowed between the two.
In fact, Zen was the only one excited and nervous. Jin was confident he could win every round, not ten times, but a hundred times, a thousand times.
'It's lucky it's rock, paper, scissors. If it was something like flipping a coin, it would've been really dangerous.'
Rock, paper, scissors, in fact, could never be a fair game for a warrior with superhuman 'hand speed'.
Jin, who can even avoid a sword containing the soul of a 10-star knight by sight, could not miss the moment the hand shape changes in rock, paper, scissors.
Like Teben before him, Zen too had no idea about this fact.
[Rock, paper, scissors!]
"Rock, I won."
[Euugh!]
"I lost this time."
[Rock, paper, scissors! A two-round win streak!]
Jin deliberately staged a fierce battle. He judged it was better in many ways to draw a picture that would satisfy Zen and ultimately win, rather than raising unnecessary suspicions.
[Paper!]
"Scissors!"
[Result, ten to eight, Jin Runcandel wins.]
Jin and Valeria clapped and laughed, and Zen bowed his head for a moment before accepting the result.
[I should've just done as I first intended and played rock... It was a good match, Jin Runcandel.]
[Zen must have learned a lot too... Haha, well learned, Jin Runcandel. Bring the communication device, Zen. It's time for the winner to monopolize.]
This time, Teben acted more significant than Zen.
[Stop bragging! Clearly, I'm better than you at rock, paper, scissors!]
[What's the result of that great rock, paper, scissors you did? That's why I wanted to flip a coin.]
The two squabbled for a while before bringing the communication device together.
Some harsh words were exchanged, but it didn't seem like anyone was genuinely upset.
[Finally, I can be free from duty, thanks for winning. Our descendants and Jin Runcandel.]
[Congratulations, to the new, champions.]
The golem clapped and congratulated Jin and Valeria.
